summary:
Here is a 3-sentence summary of the child's part of the interview:

The child has been learning to accept and feel comfortable with stuttering, and has made new friends who understand and support them. They have had positive experiences at a conference called "Friends" where they met other kids who stutter and learned that stuttering is a natural part of who they are, making them special and unique. The child feels more confident and comfortable speaking with people they know well, but may feel nervous and stutter more when meeting new people.
